combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Pantomime × The Domesday Book

entries.clue: King's officer in each county, answerable for its returns and revenue
Estate official who, with the priest and six villagers, swore the returns
Wand-waving sprite who speaks in rhyme and foils the villain's plot
Familiar name for the crisp potatoes done in the fat round the meat
Words lowered from the flies so everyone can join in
Old land tax first raised to buy off Viking fleets, still taken by William
Thickened pan juices, poured brown over spuds and meat alike
Overnight climber up to a giant's castle in the clouds
Sharpened implement drawn through the joint in even slices
Pub counter where a chef slices meat onto your plate to order
